description: Build a POP-native reaction-diffusion / growth system inside a fresh baseCOMP. Three mode presets: 'dendritic' (sparse fibrous tendrils, low decay), 'coral' (dense outward accretion, mid decay, strong force), 'lichen' (patchy crust, high threshold emission clusters). A particle_pop emits points gated by a noise threshold; a noise_pop drives a force_pop vector field that biases their motion; a feedback_pop loop carries point state forward one cook so accumulation simulates organic growth. Output is a Null TOP via poptoSOP → geometryCOMP → renderTOP. POP chain delegated to buildPopChainScript. POPs are Experimental — par writes are fail-forward; result reports unverified op/par set. Warns when feedback_gain × (1 − decay) ≥ 1.0 (divergence risk).

decay.description: Per-frame multiplier applied through the feedback loop (1 − decay retained). Overrides preset.

expose_controls.description: Expose GrowthRate / Decay / Threshold / FeedbackGain knobs on the container.

feedback_gain.description: Scale of the feedback contribution mixed back into the active POP each frame; >1 risks divergence. Overrides preset.

force_scale.description: Amplitude of the noise-driven force_pop vector field. Overrides preset.

growth_rate.description: Particle birth rate per cook (drives particle_pop birth/rate par defensively). Overrides preset.

max_points.description: Safety cap on particle count (passed defensively as numpoints/maxparticles).

mode.description: Preset selector — picks the default param bundle. 'dendritic': sparse fibrous tendrils; 'coral': dense outward accretion; 'lichen': patchy emission clusters.

noise_freq.description: Spatial frequency of the noise_pop. Overrides preset.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the container is built.

resolution.description: Render TOP + Null TOP resolution [width, height].

threshold.description: Emission gate: noise sample below threshold suppresses new births. Overrides preset.

name: create_pop_growth
title: Create POP growth preset (dendritic / coral / lichen)
